facades.name: vlaska_bab
facades.source: Street View Jul 2020 (pano 12 Vlaška, rectified from 2 frames); left part unknown; halves stitched
facades.look: a long two-storey cream-white plastered house on the north side of Vlaška (Vlaška 12 and the shop beside it), with dormers in the roof above (not drawn): on the upper floor a row of tall white-framed casement windows with shallow sills, evenly spaced, under a plain projecting cornice, a plain stringcourse between the floors. Ground floor from RIGHT to LEFT: a shop with a white band sign carrying a blue folk-art floral and bird pattern and the white letters 'BABUSHKA' in the middle with a small script line under them, an air-conditioner above its glazed door, two dark display windows with framed photographs on the wall beside the door, a blue square sign 'HOSTEL Center' with a small number plate '7' and a narrow dark passage entrance to its left, then a souvenir shop with a black fascia carrying small white lettering 'OLIVE OIL - CHEESE - TRUFFLES' and below it a white sign board with a round emblem and the small words 'SOUVENIR', 'ONLY CROATIA', 'GIFTS', and two dark glazed shopfront panels with black frames. Copy exactly. Flat grey areas and smeared blurry areas of the photo (its far left) are UNKNOWN: draw them as a natural continuation with the same window rhythm, cream colour and a simple shopfront, no text. Draw NO people, NO parked cars, NO trees, NO street furniture, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.
